A.reason: Source is titled 'Correlates of Victim-Perpetrator Overlap in Sexual Aggression among Men and Women: A Conceptual Replication and Extension' and compares nonvictim, victim-only, perpetrator-only and victim-perpetrator groups on sexual self-esteem, depression, risky sexual scripts and risky sexual behavior. That is the four-group design of Peterson et al.'s men-only study, extended here to women, though the available text never names the original.
